description:
AI Agent for Coding - Refact.ai adapts to your workflow, automating coding, debugging, and testing with full context awareness. An open-source alternative to Cursor and Copilot, Refact.ai can be deployed on-premise.

Real-time suggestions: Offers inline coding help. Supports major IDEs: Integration with JetBrains and VS Code. Secure development: Runs locally for sensitive projects. Custom prompts: Generate specific code with natural input.
